Want to try something authentic and local? Then go to 3 Mien!
Dec 2013 • Family
This is a real gem far away from the main street and all the tourist traps. If you want to try real authentic and local food that is made with quality and care then this is your top choice. It is so local that none of the staff spoke any English. This can be a challenge if you are not familiar with the local food and is seeking recommendations. However, the menu was cleverly grouped into North, Middle and South Vietnamese traditional dishes. I recommend that you order a lot of different dishes to share. This way you can better explore the local food culture. The spring rolls, rice pancakes and noodle soups are a must. The seafood was great too. Stay away from the few 'western type' dishes on the menu. This is not what the chef was trained to cook! The restaurant can be a little difficult to find as it is down a small alley way. However, just follow the signs and you find a little cozy place with lots of ambiance and atmosphere. This is a must try on your next trip to Saigon!

Vietnamese at its best, a gem which is hard to find.
Jan 2013 • Friends
I was at this restaurant first time back in 2003 and it has been on my list of places to go ever since when I visit HCMC. 

The restaurant can be a bit hard to find, so for your convenience I have uploaded the original business card from them, so you can print it out and show it to your taxi driver. Even when you are right at the small side alley where the restaurant is located, you can hardly see it, so don’t worry when you see the sign at the main street, just walk a few meters up the alleyway and you are there. 

The kitchen offers dishes from north, mid and south Vietnam, so you’ll have a good chance to try a nice selection of different local dishes and then find your favourite.

The decoration of the restaurant is a fantastic ride through art collected over a long period, I would guess. You can choose to be seated inside in the air-conditioned rooms or you can sit outside under the trees. Both choices are an experience that I hope you’ll enjoy!

I hope that this restaurant being a bit off the beaten track will be worth your while – enjoy!
